BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The cookie is read by script running in the victim browser over the network.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: The attacker also needs a separate cross-site scripting flaw to read the cookie.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: No account is needed to deliver the script.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: The victim must load the page that runs the attacker script.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The impact stays within the application session.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: A stolen session cookie gives access to the victim account data.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: The hijacked session allows limited actions as the victim.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by static analysis of the vulnerable code pattern.
